digest.component_or_area: Plan review gate T1 (overlay-priorart) criterion and web search capability routing
propositions: T1 blocking criterion lost web search grounding tool during Bedrock cutover because provider-name prefix matching (startswith('anthropic')) failed on 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'
Web search capability decision was silently withdrawn with no signal in provenance or logs, preventing detection that T1 now rules on weaker evidence (codebase/model knowledge vs current sources)
Capability routing was decided by provider-name prefix string shape rather than capability registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule for provider qualification
T1 must have web access on every provider rebar can route it to; provider-side-only design must be revisited to supply web access where native tools are unavailable

Web access decision must derive from model profile/capability registry (native_web_search field via supported_native_tools membership) rather than prefixes; provider_provenance.capabilities must record web_access state as 'native'|'local'|'off'
Security tradeoff of rebar-side web fetch (egress, caching, prompt-injection from fetched text) must be addressed explicitly if local fallback is required on any provider
